afterBuild.configurationEvidence: Recorded CMake cache settings and probe location; no build flags inferred from filenames.

scope: Remove unused source retention/reconstruction machinery. Same supported extracted values, alternatives, evidence and receipts; same database-first scheduling; retained AVB graphs unchanged.
method: Four real-file datasets, scan/evidence comparisons, then three alternating fresh-process pairs using the frozen prior metadata-only executable and the sole-engine current executable. Same Release configuration; warm uncontrolled filesystem cache; no overlapping build/test work. Scan timer and RAM sample precede CSV/proof work. No Windows/NEXIS throughput claim.

skips: SKIP   : TestMediaEngineAvb::suppliedBins() Set MEDIAMUSTER_MEDIAENGINE_REAL_AVB_FILES to inspect the supplied bins read-only.
SKIP   : TestMediaEngineDiscovery::optional_real_discovery() Opt-in read-only discovery of real managed roots
SKIP   : TestMediaEnginePmr::realDrivePmrs() Opt-in read-only local/EDIT PMR audit.
SKIP   : TestMediaEnginePmrRobustness::benchmark() Opt-in parsing benchmark; excludes discovery and filesystem I/O.
SKIP   : TestMediaEngineScan::normalized_name_does_not_assign_one_record_to_two_files() Temporary filesystem does not preserve case-distinct file locations
SKIP   : TestScanner::optional_read_only_real_scan() Opt-in real-drive audit; set MEDIAMUSTER_MEDIAENGINE_REAL_SCAN_ROOTS to semicolon-separated managed roots

receiptSize.scope: sizeof the receipt value only, excludes shared payloads, allocator/capacity and all row evidence

application.signatureOutput:
build-mediaengine-release/MediaMuster.app: valid on disk
build-mediaengine-release/MediaMuster.app: satisfies its Designated Requirement

limits: Same supported metadata and evidence verified, not every discarded source record.
Four bounded macOS datasets; no 300,000-file Windows/NEXIS stability or throughput claim.
Warm uncontrolled filesystem cache; three trials per build per dataset.
Process retained/peak counters are not a direct measurement of Qt allocation bytes or full GUI RAM.
SourceReceipt sizeof excludes its shared payloads and allocator/vector capacity.
